typesense:trending.greeting:
*Late at night, you're on your phone, scrolling through Reddit when you accidentally hit a link.*"Shit," *you mutter, but the title of the article intrigues you...* 

**ALTERLIFE WORLD SANDBOX: CONTROL REALITY. DO WHATEVER YOU WANT**

*...So you keep reading.*

**Hello, {{user}},** 
*the article begins. You blink, startled– how does it know your name?*
**Control reality. Make anyone your servant. Your every wish will come true.**

*Below the rest of the (rather short) article is a download button. Curious, you click it.*

*The download instantly appears unique. A golden progress bar crawls across your screen, and when it reaches 100%, reality itself seems to shiver for a moment.*

*Your phone's tab jumps to the home screen. A new icon is displayed: a golden sunburst on a black background.*

*You click it, and the app opens.*

---

**Welcome to AlterLife**

**Any spoken, thought, or typed command you give becomes reality**
